conflict_detection_policy.content: Campaign Conflict Detection Policy v3.1 (effective 2026-01-01). A SCHEDULING CONFLICT exists when two or more campaigns target the same segment within a 48-hour window. An AUDIENCE OVERLAP RISK exists when segments with >40% mutual overlap have campaigns scheduled within a 72-hour window, breaching the 2-email frequency cap. Conflicts must be triaged by severity: HIGH (same segment, same day), MEDIUM (overlapping segments within 72h), LOW (adjacent-day, non-overlapping). Resolution proposals are drafted for the campaign owner; no schedule change is made without owner sign-off.
